# DS Photography & Films

> Fine-art wedding photography, candid couple monographs, and cinematic wedding films based in Mumbai, Maharashtra, founded and led by lead photographer and cinematographer Dishant Shelar.

DS Photography & Films documents bespoke weddings, intimate pre-wedding journeys, fine-art portraits, celebrations, and commercial brand commissions across Mumbai, Maharashtra, and destination estates worldwide. The studio's visual ethos emphasizes natural ambient light, medium format film tonality, unscripted emotional intimacy, and timeless archival storytelling.

## Primary Photography Collections

- [Master Collections Archive](https://www.dishantshelarphotography.in/collections): Curated master photography gallery and monograph archive across all atelier disciplines.
- [Wedding Photography in Mumbai](https://www.dishantshelarphotography.in/collections/weddings): Candid wedding stories, ritual documentation, fine-art portraits, and luxury wedding cinematography in Mumbai.
- [Pre-Wedding Photography & Films](https://www.dishantshelarphotography.in/collections/pre-wedding): Intimate cinematic couple sessions, sunset monographs, and story-driven pre-wedding films.
- [Editorial Portraits](https://www.dishantshelarphotography.in/collections/portraits): Studio and daylight personal portraiture, creative direction, and fine-art monographs.
- [Birthday Celebrations](https://www.dishantshelarphotography.in/collections/birthdays): Atmospheric milestone birthday and family celebration documentation.
- [Events & Galas](https://www.dishantshelarphotography.in/collections/events): Exclusive cultural soirées, luxury galas, and private event documentation.
- [Commercial & Brand Commissions](https://www.dishantshelarphotography.in/collections/commercial): Haute commercial brand campaigns, luxury product monographs, and fashion editorial photography.
